notes:
### Fixed

- Paired Tailscale devices now try a cached or discovered local-network address before using embedded Tailscale. Automatic discovery requires an updated receiving device and local UDP access.
- Filtered meeting pre-recording reminders now appear when temporary capture starts, even if the earlier detection reminder was hidden.
- Pre-recording uses a distinct status and confirmation action; keeping the recording switches to the normal recording indicator without resetting the timer.
- Discarded temporary recordings no longer immediately reopen the same meeting reminder.
- Meeting pre-recording indicators are more compact, with vertically aligned text and controls and a plain elapsed-time display.
- Live meeting windows place the macOS window controls on their own row, keeping the meeting title, model selector and actions together below.
- Automatic insertion uses the standard clipboard-and-paste flow, requests required permissions when needed, and distinguishes copy failures from paste failures.
- Refreshed the native macOS icon catalog and the full-resolution fallback icon used by older systems.

This release is available for macOS on Apple silicon. Windows and Linux downloads remain at version 0.2.6.

notes_i18n.zh-CN:
### 修复

- 已配对的 Tailscale 设备优先尝试缓存或自动发现的局域网地址，失败后再使用内置 Tailscale。自动发现需要接收端更新并允许局域网 UDP 通信。
- 被过滤会议开始预录制时，提示胶囊正常显示，不再继承之前检测提示的隐藏状态。
- 预录制使用独立状态与保留按钮；确认保留后切换为正常录制指示，计时保持连续。
- 丢弃临时录音后，不再立即重新弹出同一会议的检测提示。
- 预录制胶囊更紧凑，文字与操作按钮垂直居中，计时使用不带前导圆点的纯数字显示。
- 实时会议窗口的红绿灯独占一行，会议标题、模型选择与操作按钮保持在下方同一行。
- 自动填入采用标准剪贴板与粘贴流程，按需申请所需权限，并明确区分复制失败与粘贴失败。
- 重新生成 macOS 原生图标资源和供旧系统使用的完整分辨率回退图标。

本次发布适用于搭载 Apple 芯片的 macOS。Windows 与 Linux 下载仍保留在 0.2.6。
